title: Window mockup: window mockup with background color (daisyUI)
notes:
Window mockup shows a box that looks like an operating system window.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/mockup-window/+page.md
